name: 🌟 Weekly Gratitude & Reflection
description: Deeply reflect on meaningful moments, connections, and growth from the past week

onSelect.message: Ready for some deep reflection? Let's honor this week together... 🌟

onStart.message: Let's take a moment to honor the past week. It's not just about what you did, but how you felt. 💖

onComplete.message: It feels wonderful to acknowledge the good in your life. Carry this warmth into the week ahead.

onSave.message: Week reflected and saved! Your gratitude practice is beautiful 🌟

onStart.message: What moments this week brought you joy, peace, or connection? 💫

sections.title: Savoring an Experience
sections.placeholder: Choose one moment from above and explore it deeply...

suggested_questions: What exactly happened, and what did it look, sound, and feel like?
What emotions were present during this experience?
Why did this moment resonate so deeply with me?

onStart.message: Take your time with this one. Really try to relive that feeling.

onComplete.message: This depth of reflection is powerful. You're truly savoring life 💎

hints: Close your eyes and picture the moment
What sensory details do you remember?
How did your body feel during this experience?
What made this moment different from others?
